android.desc: Unpluq helps you focus and feel better by recovering your time. Reduce your screen time by stopping your habit of picking up your phone–and stop scrolling. Recover your time, focus, and attention by making a conscious choice every time you want to access an app. The average Unpluq customer saves more than 1 hour and 22 minutes a day of screen time.* Try it free for a week and see how it changes your life! NOTE ON TRUST: The vast majority of free apps survive and pay for their costs (development and operations) by selling your data and showing you ads. Unpluq does NOT show you ads and it does NOT sell your data. ⭐️7 Day Free Trial⭐️ Unpluq Premium Subscription ⭐️ Enjoy a 7 day free trial. Save 2x as much time with premium. - Unlimited: block apps–as many as you like - Unlimited: schedules–work schedule, weekend schedule, you decide what works best for you - Whitelist contacts, so notifications from them always get through - All Barriers: Use all the available barrier options, including the patented Unpluq Tag, the keyfob that keeps you focused, as well as Walking (Steps), Scrolling, Charging, Random, or QR code barriers. Block Apps 🚫 When You Need To - Stay focused - Focus during work - Disconnect after hours - Be present for family meals - Avoid working on the weekends - Study uninterrupted - Be more mindful every day - Sleep and rest well - Reduce stress - Lower anxiety Use Unpluq To 🎯 - Block distracting apps and notifications–by default - Choose only the apps you want to block - Unblock apps by making a conscious decision with an Unpluq distraction barrier - Select the distraction barrier you prefer, or go RANDOM to make it harder - Choose how it is to access your apps - Block different apps on different schedules - Track your progress and understand your screen time ❓How Unpluq Works Select which apps to block, and when. If you need to access a blocked app, make a conscious choice to open it by passing through an Unpluq Distraction Barrier–a digital key that makes you think twice and ensure you really do want to open that app. To open blocked apps, you need to take a walk, shake your phone, follow a random pattern by tapping, charge your phone, or use the Unpluq Tag keyfob (the most effective barrier). Choose Your Distraction Barrier 🚧 –and make it as hard as you want - Take a walk/steps - Shake your phone - Tap a random pattern of buttons - Scroll through space - R

quotes.text:
We've been building an app to help you to make your smartphone screentime more conscious and we've just opened the beta this week! <https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.unpluq.beta&referrer=utm_source%3Dhackernews%26utm_medium%3Dpost%26utm_campaign%3Dhackernews_post>

It basically blocks distracting apps by default and gives you a barrier to open them like shaking your phone for a couple of seconds! Eager to hear what any of you think of it!
